# Pixabay
> Pixabay is a royalty-free media platform offering free stock photos, illustrations, vectors, videos, music, sound effects, and GIFs.

Pixabay provides downloadable creative assets for personal and commercial use, along with contributor resources, licensing information, and an API for programmatic access to its media library.

## Media Discovery
- [Photos](https://pixabay.com/images/search/): Browse free stock photos across a wide range of subjects and styles.
- [Illustrations](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/search/): Explore royalty-free illustrations for editorial, creative, and commercial projects.
- [Vectors](https://pixabay.com/vectors/search/): Find scalable vector graphics suitable for design and print use.
- [Videos](https://pixabay.com/videos/search/): Search free stock video clips for websites, presentations, and productions.
- [Music](https://pixabay.com/music/): Discover royalty-free music tracks for videos, podcasts, and other media.
- [Sound Effects](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/): Browse free sound effects for multimedia and production workflows.
- [GIFs](https://pixabay.com/gifs/search/): Find animated GIFs for social, editorial, and creative use.

## Search and Collections
- [Latest Uploads](https://pixabay.com/images/search/latest/): View recently added image assets from the Pixabay community.
- [Popular Images](https://pixabay.com/images/search/popular/): Explore trending and frequently downloaded image content.
- [Editor's Choice](https://pixabay.com/images/search/editors_choice/): Browse curated media selected by Pixabay editors.
- [Trending Searches](https://pixabay.com/images/search/trending/): Discover currently popular search topics and visual themes.
- [Collections](https://pixabay.com/collections/): Access grouped sets of media organized around themes and topics.

## API and Developer Resources
- [API Documentation](https://pixabay.com/api/docs/): Learn how to search and retrieve Pixabay media programmatically.
- [API Reference](https://pixabay.com/api/docs/#api_search_images): Review image search parameters, filters, and response fields.
- [Video API Reference](https://pixabay.com/api/docs/#api_search_videos): Understand video search endpoints and returned metadata.
- [API Key Signup](https://pixabay.com/accounts/register/): Create an account to obtain credentials for Pixabay API access.

## Licensing and Usage
- [Content License](https://pixabay.com/service/license-summary/): Read the summary of Pixabay’s royalty-free content usage terms.
- [License Details](https://pixabay.com/service/terms/): Review the full terms governing use of Pixabay content and services.
- [Content Safety](https://pixabay.com/service/faq/): Find guidance on attribution, model releases, and permitted uses.
- [DMCA](https://pixabay.com/service/dmca/): Learn how copyright complaints and takedown requests are handled.

## Help and Support
- [FAQ](https://pixabay.com/service/faq/): Get answers to common questions about downloads, licensing, and accounts.
- [Contact](https://pixabay.com/service/about/contact/): Reach Pixabay for support, feedback, and general inquiries.
- [About](https://pixabay.com/service/about/): Learn about Pixabay’s mission, platform, and community.
- [Imprint](https://pixabay.com/service/about/imprint/): View legal publisher and company information for the site.

## Accounts and Contribution
- [Register](https://pixabay.com/accounts/register/): Create a Pixabay account to download, like, and contribute content.
- [Login](https://pixabay.com/accounts/login/): Sign in to manage your profile, uploads, and saved items.
- [Upload](https://pixabay.com/images/upload/): Submit photos, illustrations, and other assets to the platform.
- [Forum](https://pixabay.com/forum/): Participate in community discussions around content and platform usage.
- [Users](https://pixabay.com/users/): Explore contributor profiles and their published media libraries.

## Legal and Policies
- [Terms of Service](https://pixabay.com/service/terms/): Review the legal terms for using Pixabay and its services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://pixabay.com/service/privacy/): Understand how Pixabay collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [Cookie Policy](https://pixabay.com/service/cookie-policy/): Learn about cookies and related tracking technologies on the site.
- [Community Rules](https://pixabay.com/service/rules/): Read the standards governing uploads and community participation.

- [Blog](https://pixabay.com/blog/): Read updates, announcements, and stories related to Pixabay content and creators.
